overview_description.description:
Adeer is an innovative business management app designed for small to medium-sized businesses and freelancers. With features like sales management, digital invoicing, inventory tracking, and financial analysis, Adeer simplifies operations and empowers users to efficiently manage their business activities. Available in both Arabic and English, the app is user-friendly, making it accessible to everyone, regardless of technical skill.

In addition to the app, adeer offers innovative solutions for medium & large corporates to streamline their operations. adeer have recently launched their Ai Doc Chatbot which makes finding information and tech consulting services.Our team provides tailored solutions in software development and automation, helping businesses optimize their operations and achieve sustainable growth.

product.name: adeer app
product.description: A business management application for small to medium-sized businesses and freelancers to manage sales, inventory, finances, payroll, taxes, and reports.

product.name: AI Advisor
product.description: An AI-powered assistant that provides business insights and support 24/7 to help users manage their operations.

product.name: Sales and Orders Tracking
product.description: A module to monitor business profits by tracking sales and managing customer orders with digital invoicing.

product.name: Product and Inventory Management
product.description: A system to manage products, stock levels, and calculate total product value to optimize inventory control.

product.name: Finance and Expense Tracking
product.description: A tool for tracking expenses, generating financial graphs, and calculating profit and loss to simplify financial management.

product.name: Tax Management
product.description: A feature that automates tax calculation, organizes tax-related data, and generates tax reports to aid compliance.
